The '''blood beetle''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of scavenging [[Insect/Legends|insect]]. The [[Beetle/Legends|beetles]] had the ability to locate a [[Death/Legends|corpse]] and [[Diet/Legends|devour]] it down to the [[Bone/Legends|bone]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blood beetles were first mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>
